items.headline: O: $122B committed capital round closed
items.summary: O said it closed a funding round with $122B in committed capital at a $852B post-money valuation; it also cited enterprise momentum and compute-led strategy.

items.headline: O: GPT-6 rollout announced (Astra family)
items.summary: O updated with GPT-6 Astra (plus GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna) and states it’s rolling out to select orgs before broad availability via ChatGPT and API.
